note: From the entry 2. Neotermes megaoculatus in Mukherjee et al., Termite (Isoptera) fauna of the Himalaya including its zoogeographical analysis (Memoirs of the Zoological Survey of India 21(2)), where the original lists the alate and the soldier under Diagnostic Character. Measurements in Table 5; that table sets the two columns for N. kalimpongensis and N. megaoculatus side by side, and only the latter (paratype/known range) is taken here; values given as - in the original for the paratype are recorded as —. Distribution: Western Himalaya (Dehra Dun, Kanda, New Forest; Pauri).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head and postclypeus pale brown to dark brown; labrum and pronotum brown. Hairs on the head and pronotum sparse. Head nearly oval, slightly wider than long, the sides gradually converging backwards, Y suture distinct. Ocelli translucent, large, oval, almost touching the eye plate. Antennae 18—19-segmented, segment 2 much longer than segment 3; segment 3 longer than segment 4. Clypeus trapezoidal. Labrum ligulate, hairy. Mandibles of the Neotermes type. Pronotum nearly rectangular, wider than the head (including the compound eyes); anterior margin broadly concave; posterior margin nearly straight. Wing venation broadly as in the genus.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head brown to dark brown, body white. Head nearly rectangular, posterior margin rounded. Antennae 14—16-segmented, segment 3 about as long as segment 2; segment 4 shortest. Labrum much wider than long; anterior margin slightly convex, with several hairs at the apex and on the body. Mandibles robust, longer than half the head length (to the mandible base). Left mandible with 3—5 small to large marginal teeth, right mandible with 2 large triangular marginal teeth. Postmentum club-shaped, the anterior part bilobed. Pronotum nearly rectangular, hairs sparse, anterior margin broadly concave, without a distinct median notch, posterior margin nearly straight. Measurements (paratype/known range, mm): head length (to lateral mandible base) 3.60/3.60—4.50; maximum head width 2.55/2.60—2.88; maximum diameter of the compound eye 0.30/0.30—0.42; head index 0.71; maximum labrum length 0.35/0.36—0.42, maximum width 0.58/0.60—0.78; left mandible length 1.96/2.00—2.76; head-mandible index 0.54/0.50—0.65; minimum median postmentum length —/2.76—3.36, maximum width —/0.90—1.02, waist width —/0.30—0.43; maximum pronotal length 1.48/1.10—1.62, maximum width —/2.46—3.00; number of antennal segments 16/14—16.
